Native-safe storage (contract rules 4,5,7): window.localStorage is browser-only. getWebStorage() feature-detects it (full persistence on react-native-web). On bare native there is no synchronous Web Storage, so the draft is remembered in a module-level in-memory store for the app lifetime — this preserves the web 'accidental navigation away+back does not discard a long draft' intent; only across-process-restart persistence (which needs AsyncStorage) degrades, and that degradation is explicit, not silent.
